description: The contract register: leases, service agreements, maintenance, insurance — anything with a term and a notice period. Optional: status (draft|active|terminated|expired|archived|all, default active), contract_type, our_role, counterparty (substring), account_id, expiring_within_days (contracts whose term ends inside that window), q (title/reference search, also path fragments like 'Ordner\Unterordner'; a UUID or 'source:uuid' is matched exactly against reference), reference (exact reference match, for idempotent imports), limit (default 50, max 100), offset (paging: with offset you get { total, offset, next_offset, contracts } instead of a bare list; next_offset is null on the last page), compact (true = only id, title, contract_type, status, our_role, account_id, contact_id, our_account_id, reference — for walking a large register; implies the paged form), our_account_id (contracts of one of OUR group companies), intra_group (true = counterparty is also an own company (accounts.is_own_company), false = everything else: no linked organisation or one that is not own). Each row carries next_deadline so you can see what is about to lapse without a second call, and source_root_id + source_file_id (the connected-drive origin of a folder-imported contract) so an idempotency check needs no per-contract get_contract.

compact.description: Return only key fields in paged form, for walking a large register

counterparty.description: Substring filter on the counterparty name

expiring_within_days.description: Only contracts whose term ends within this many days

intra_group.description: true = counterparty is one of our own companies, false = all others

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

our_role.description: Only contracts where we have this role

reference.description: Exact reference match, for idempotent imports

name: list_contracts
